# lib/console module

Line-based command dispatcher over epic-serial. This page is the reference for the `lib/console` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

| Parts, PIC16F88X | 16F886, 16F887 |

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/console` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/console). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 16F870, 16F871, 16F872, 16F873, 16F873A, 16F874, 16F874A, 16LF873A, 18F2455, 18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
